main_text.p: Et quidem vel Æquabiliter, vel inæ-quabiliter.
Æquabiliter, qui ex æquabili extremorum contemperatione, tanquam exactè Medius gignitur.
Estque color ruber vel rubeus, qui est medius, ex æquali albedinis & nigredinis contemperatione ortus: seu ex utroque extremorum luminis habens mediocritatem.Ruber.
Inæquabiliter, qui ex inæquabili extremorum contemperatione ortus, uni propius, alteri longinquius accedit: vel ex alterutro extremorum & rubedine gignitur.
Hic vel propius ad alborem, vel propius ad nigrorem accedit, ita ut vel plus alboris, quàm ruboris, vel minus alboris, & plus ruboris habeat: Ille flavus hic croceus dicitur.
Flavus color ex albedine minus intensa, aliquantulum ad rubedinem accedente generatur.Flavus.
Croceus color ex rubedine minus intensa, aliquantulum ad albedinem accedente gignitur.Croceus.

page.notes: The page number is printed as "53" in a form that resembles "s3"; read as 53 with doubt. Faint show-through from the reverse page appears in the left and right margins and in the text area; it is not transcribed. The catchword "flatus" is at the foot right and is not repeated in the text. The paragraph ends on the hyphenated "con-" as printed. The italic words in "Ruber" and "rubeus" are read as italic.
